question: According to Census 2011, in which State is the difference in the male and female literacy rates the highest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to Census 2011, Rajasthan recorded the **highest difference in male and female literacy rates** among Indian states.
 
• The male literacy rate in Rajasthan was approximately **80.51%**, whereas the female literacy rate stood at **52.66%**, creating a significant gap of **27.85%**.
 
• This disparity highlights **gender inequality** in education, particularly in rural areas of Rajasthan.
 
• Efforts have been made by the state government through programs like **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** and Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan to bridge the literacy gap.
 
• Rajasthan has historically faced challenges such as **socio-cultural norms and lack of access to education for women**, contributing to this disparity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate**

 
 
• Literacy rate refers to the percentage of the population aged 7 years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• It is an essential indicator of a region's social and economic development.
 
 
 
• **Gender Disparity in Literacy**
 
 
• Gender disparity in literacy rates is caused by factors like traditional societal norms, poverty, and lack of access to education.
 
• Government schemes such as **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** aim to reduce this disparity by promoting girl child education.
 
 
 
• **Census 2011**
 
 
• Census 2011 is the 15th Indian Census conducted by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on population, literacy rates, employment, and housing conditions.
 
 
 
• **Schemes to Promote Literacy**
 
 
• **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan:** Focuses on universal access to education and improving literacy rates.
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** Aims to improve gender equality in education and combat discrimination against girls.
